about: Chat 9 round 12 (HQ Oct 28 12:50 AM, chat 8's KPC_HistoricSites_desk.md): state historic-boundary sources after the National Register count: NC HPO shapefile (find the monthly zip, size, date, licence; NO licence stated per the desk = list it until the HPO says yes, ruling Q6), Tennessee's own National Register polygons, Kentucky's National Register Landmarks (points or polygons?). Plus round 9 leftovers: Upper Thames conservation authority layer (OGL-Ontario), PEI provincial park polygons' fields. NPS units use NPS boundaries first. Results: round12-tested.json. + (HQ 12:52 AM) Idaho Parks' open-data hub: the DOWNLOADABLE state-park boundary file (not the live server, which times out from runners).
